profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Cohealo, Inc.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- worked the full stack in developing for the college's parking infrastructure:
  - frontend (Bootstrap/ JS, HTML/CSS)
  - backend (Ruby, Rails 4/5, Capistrano, MariaDB/SQL) 
  - testing (unit testing, RSpec)
- managed and created features like Garage Closings, Meter Audits, Permit Holder SMS, and etc.
- collaborated in creating a parking pass creator in Sinatra
- practiced agile development; feedback from admins, front staff, Parking enforcements, and customers

projects.title: Emota
projects.description: Emota is a technology tool to aid people with autism spectrum disorder to visualize conversation mood and conversation partner's emotions. The hardware includes a camera and a raspberry pi to interact with our AWS servers and APIs. It utilizes racial recognition and emotion detection and returns as an user friendly score to the smartwatch of the Emota user.
